intervention: For each token at XGLM hidden state 12, compute the selected fixed-threshold SAE activation and subtract a_f * W_dec[f] / activation_scale from the residual stream.
intervention_side_rule: Use training data only. Ablate whichever condition (basis or changed) has higher mean target-feature activation.
primary_outcome: Attenuation of a train-only linguistic pair-difference direction measured at the final XGLM hidden layer on heldout val/test.
positive_attenuation_means: Ablation reduced the downstream distinction between changed and basis.
controls: 3 other selected SAE features matched using training-only activation magnitude, firing rate, and decoder norm.
